claims.author: Yudis-bit
claims.harm: in cat_dup_test, premature break statements skip testing push size limits and element sizes above 260 bytes
claims.quote: breaking when `catedStackElementSize > MAX_SCRIPT_ELEMENT_SIZE` skips `DoTest()` for the push size limit, and `if (expectedErr == SCRIPT_ERR_OK) break;` terminates on `dups = 1`. Elements above 260 bytes and `SCRIPT_ERR_PUSH_SIZE` are never tested.

claims.author: Yudis-bit
claims.harm: when OP_CAT is disabled, opcode 0x7e bypasses policy rejection and returns success if SCRIPT_VERIFY_DISCOURAGE_OP_SUCCESS is set without SCRIPT_VERIFY_DISCOURAGE_OP_CAT
claims.quote: If a caller sets `DISCOURAGE_OP_SUCCESS` without the new `DISCOURAGE_OP_CAT` flag while `OP_CAT` is disabled, `0x7e` bypasses policy rejection and returns success.
